tools.description: Report what the user's BeatScope studio currently shows: the loaded song's measured summary, playback position and which media clock owns it, the deterministic movie template and seed, any active render job, and which of the other tools can work right now. Call this first. It describes the visible document only and never lists songs the user has not opened.
tools.name: beatscope_get_studio_state
tools.title: Read the BeatScope studio state

tools.description: Read the loaded song's measured facts inside one bounded window: beats, onsets, cues, structural segments and boundaries. Every time is the exact measured second - nothing is quantised, moved, merged or renamed, and no instrument identity is invented. Give either a time window or an inclusive measured bar window, never both. Read-only: playback does not move.

cue_types.description: Cue families to include when cues are requested.

end_bar.description: Last bar of an inclusive measured bar window.

end_time.description: Window end in measured seconds; exclusive of the start.

include.description: Which facts to return. Defaults to beats, onsets and cues.

start_bar.description: First bar of an inclusive measured bar window.

start_time.description: Window start in measured seconds; the window is (start, end].

tools.name: beatscope_inspect_timing
tools.title: Inspect measured timing

tools.description: Return a caller-sized set of the loaded song's existing onsets that are worth considering for animation, editing or scene changes, selected by the measured response-relevance sidecar. A budget is a count, not a threshold: the events are the original onsets, unshifted, and come back in chronological order. When the song has no relevance sidecar this fails with ranking_unavailable instead of passing chronological order off as a ranking.

band.description: Prefer events with the strongest evidence in one measured band.

end_bar.description: Last bar of an inclusive measured bar window.

end_time.description: Window end in measured seconds; exclusive of the start.

start_bar.description: First bar of an inclusive measured bar window.

start_time.description: Window start in measured seconds; the window is (start, end].

tools.name: beatscope_get_response_events
tools.title: Get ranked response events

tools.description: Explain a real decision in the current deterministic movie plan for the loaded song: which shot covers a time or shot index, where its cut came from (the song start, a structural boundary, or a ranked onset with its original id and measured time), and which visual world the plan assigned to it. The plan is produced by the same deterministic function the live preview and the renderer use. A structural family is recurrence evidence, never a section name.

shot_index.description: Zero-based shot index instead of a time.

time.description: Media time to explain; defaults to the current playhead.

tools.name: beatscope_explain_movie
tools.title: Explain the current movie cut

tools.description: Operate the visible media element: play, pause, seek to a time or a measured bar, audition a range (it stops at the range end), or restore the position and play state that were saved before the last audition. It never changes the song, the seed, the movie plan or any export. A blocked autoplay is reported honestly instead of being hidden.

bar.description: Seek target bar, converted from measured downbeats.

beat.description: Beat inside the target bar; only with bar.

tools.name: beatscope_control_playback
tools.title: Control playback

tools.description: Start one deterministic render of the loaded song using the current seed or a supplied 24-bit seed, or cancel the active render. Starting uses the same path as the visible Generate button: a supplied seed becomes the visible seed before the preview and the render begin. It returns as soon as the job exists - read progress with beatscope_get_studio_state - and it never replaces a running render. Cancelling uses the same path as the visible Cancel button.
tools.name: beatscope_render_movie
tools.title: Render the movie

tools.description: Start the visible timing-package download for the loaded song: measured timing facts, the deterministic runtime, the self-check probe, the Skill and agent guidance, MIDI and CSV. Source audio, the movie, the visual template, scenes and any task statement are excluded. The archive bytes never enter the result.
tools.name: beatscope_export_timing_package
tools.title: Export the timing package
